We also check names and handles so people find you easily. You receive a short sheet with every profile link and the wording we used.

faq: Which channels do you set up?
Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube and X are the usual ones. Tell us where your buyers are, and we advise if a channel is not worth your time yet.
Do I need to have logos and photos ready?
Send your logo and a few brand images if you have them. If not, we make simple profile graphics from your logo and colors. We use only images you own or have the right to use.
Can you take over an old profile?
Yes, if you are an admin of it. You add us as a manager from the platform's own settings, and we update it without ever asking for your password.
Can you set up profiles for me under your own account?
No. Profiles must belong to you, so you can always control them. We create or edit them inside your own logins, with you as owner.
